messages:
kevin rao: Quick thread — want to define an apples-to-apples smoke sweep for kernel selection + batching heuristics + KV cache behavior, and then run quality/perf tradeoff experiments (quant profiles + speculative decoding). Goal: agree on methodology + regression gates so QA + eng can reproduce.

mira singh: +1. Two workload modes: (A) replay harness using a prod-sampled trace slice (preserves KV/prefix patterns) and (B) synthetic generator where we enforce the same token-length histogram and concurrency mix. Both needed.

alex kim: Replay is highest fidelity for KV patterns. For synthetic, we should seed with the same histogram and also emulate prefix-sharing (eg: 20% identical prefixes). Run each config 3x with different RNG seeds to get noise bands.

sara taylor: Metrics proposal: p50/p90/p99 latency (server-side), tail token latency (per-request token timing), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory, cost/tokens. Also quality checks: perplexity on holdout, and a small eval set (50 prompts) for semantic regressions.

jonah li: KV warmup plan: measure both cold (KV cleared) and warm (run 500 warmup requests) conditions. Report cold->warm delta and warm steady-state. Also record KV hit ratio and KV cache bytes growth.

kevin rao: For kernel selection we need to fix the model binary (same weights/quant state) and only toggle runtime kernels: `auto`, `fused-attn`, `flash-attn`, `int8-kernel-v2`. That avoids weight/regressions conflating with kernel change.

mira singh: Agreed. Quantization experiments must be separate: run baseline float32, then q8_0, q4_0 variants with identical kernels when comparing quality. Speculative decoding toggles can be layered on top but measured independently for wasted tokens metric.

perf-bot: Suggested test command snippet:
```
./tools/run_sweep
  --workload replay
  --trace ./traces/slice-2026-02-14.json
  --kernel auto,fused-attn,flash-attn,int8-kernel-v2
  --quant float32,q8_0,q4_0
  --speculative on,off
  --kv-mode cold,warm
  --runs 3
  --out ./sweep-results/$RUN_ID
```

sara taylor: Regression gates (proposal): block a rollout if any of the following vs baseline:
- p99 latency increase > 5%
- cost/tokens increase > 7%
- token throughput drop > 6%
- eval quality drop (accuracy/perplexity) > 1% relative or absolute, depending on metric
We can relax thresholds for experimental branches but prod-bound merges should follow these.

j onah li: Small nit: p99 is noisy. Recommend looking at p99-mean over 3 runs and use median of runs as the comparison point. Also include p95-to-p99 slope as an indicator of tail behavior shift.

mira singh: Good call. Also: for apples-to-apples we must pin request routing: no fallbacks to alternative models or regions. Use single model version and single region nodepool.

alex kim: For batching heuristics test matrix: vary max_batch_size [1,4,8,16], batching timeout [1ms,5ms,10ms], and dynamic batching enabled/disabled. Use the same client concurrency and inter-arrival distribution across runs.

kevin rao: Important: track KV related latency per-step — e.g., token generation vs KV fetch time vs kernel execution time. Add a small profiler tag in runtime traces: `kv_fetch_ms`, `kernel_exec_ms`, `batch_wait_ms`.

perf-bot: Example runtime profile line:
`trace: request_id=abc123 kv_fetch_ms=2.1 kernel_exec_ms=18.3 batch_wait_ms=1.2 total_ms=22.6 gpu_busy=87%`

sara taylor: Speculative decoding measurement: report wasted tokens (tokens generated speculatively that then get thrown away), extra latency introduced on spec-hit vs non-spec-hit, and overall tokens/sec. We'll compute effective cost = cost_tokens + wasted_tokens * token_cost.

mira singh: Action items:
- mira: assemble replay slice and upload to `traces/` (due EOD Wed)
- alex: synthetic generator + prefix-emulation update (due Thu)
- jonah: add `kv_fetch_ms` instrumentation and cold/warm cleared-state helper (due Thu)
- kevin: create the sweep config matrix in `sweeps/` and add baseline run id (due Fri)
- sara: define eval set and evaluation notebook (due Fri)
Everyone: run a quick smoke — 1 kernel x 1 quant x cold/warm x 1 seed — and paste initial numbers in this thread when done.

kevin rao: I'll start baseline run now (float32, `auto` kernel, warm KV). Posting when complete.

alex kim: If anyone needs the synthetic runner: `python tools/synth_gen.py --hist hist.json --prefix-share 0.2 --qps 120`

mira singh: +1 :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Note: do not forget to tag runs with `sweep_tag=kernel-batching-kv-2026-02` so we can query in the dashboard.

kevin rao: baseline done: p50=12.4ms p90=28.1ms p99=65.3ms tokens/sec=12.4k gpu=83% cost/tok=$0.000042 — uploading full trace to `sweeps/baseline-1845001234.json`

sara taylor: nice. Please include the eval quality numbers too (perplexity + pass@1).

kevin rao: added eval: ppl=14.2 pass@1=0.78

jonah li: pulling baseline traces to validate KV hit ratios now.

mira singh: Thanks all — we'll reconvene with initial sweep results Tue AM and decide gate thresholds concretely based on more data. :eyes:
